newsitem.title: USA: BOC Group unit plans $25 mln Oregon plant.
newsitem.headline: BOC Group unit plans $25 mln Oregon plant.

text.p: BOC Gases, a unit of Britain's BOC Group, said it would invest $25 million to build an advanced electronic cylinder gas plant in the Medford, Oregon area, providing up to 50 high-tech jobs.
The plant was set to begin operations in 1998, BOC said.
It would meet purity and volume requirements of semiconductor makers adopting stringent process geometries, including 0.25 micron and 0.18 micron, the company said.
BOC said it would use proprietary purification techniques to ensure critical impurities, like moisture or metals, were controlled to parts per billion.
BOC Gases is the industrial gases business of BOC Group.
